title: ZXing does not work on Android 14
body:
xDrip has been using ZXing for years.

It seems that it's not being updated any longer:
https://github.com/zxing/zxing  
![Screenshot 2024-10-08 161104](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/47f79d7e-3fbd-4bab-b57c-b49a5f942402)


We have already had several reports of the scanner screen not fully opening.  
  
I tested the option of scanning from a saved image on Android 15 as well.  So, that option works.  But, the option to use the camera does not work on some phones sometimes.  

I hope we can find a solution.

comments.body: I wonder if this may be a solution: https://github.com/mchehab/zbar

It turns out all you have to do is to rotate the phone to go into the landscape mode before attempting to scan.  Then, the scan window opens in the center of the screen:
https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/pull/4064
As of the 2025.10.04 release, the problem has been resolved.
